newsitem.title: UK: Shell's Jennings holds talks with Chinese premier.
newsitem.headline: Shell's Jennings holds talks with Chinese premier.

text.p: Shell Transport and Trading Co Chairman John Jennings met Chinese Premier Li Peng in Beijing on Friday to discuss the company's future cooperation with China, the Chinese Xinhua news agency reported.
A Shell spokesman in London said he had no details of the talks.

Xinhua quoted Li as saying China had "good faith" in the company and "believes that a satisfactory cooperative plan can be mapped out through discussions based on the principle of equality and mutual benefit."

The agency, monitored in London, quoted Jennings as saying that he discussed Shell's cooperation with China, especially in the South China Sea, with the heads of the State Planning Commission and other departments.
Shell is planning a $6 billion joint venture refinery and petrochemical project in Huizhou in the southern province of Guangdong.
